connections.reason: Lines of text to and from the peers each link in the settings names: a TCP client (with TLS if chosen), a TCP server on loopback unless an admin chooses an address, or UDP. The hosts and ports come only from the links.

groups.label: Greeting
groups.description: What the template's panel and endpoint show.

groups.label: Links
groups.description: The connections the template keeps, one entry per link. Replace this example with your plugin's own.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: The text the greeting endpoint and panel show.

links.title: Links
links.description: The connections to peers, one entry per link. Without an entry the template opens none. A link receives lines of text, sends them, or both; its state shows in the plugin's status.

x-emc2.hint: One entry per peer or port

groups.label: Peer
groups.description: Where a TCP client connects and where UDP sends.

groups.label: Listening
groups.description: Where a TCP server or a receiving UDP link listens.

groups.label: Timing
groups.description: When a quiet connection is opened again.

id.title: Id
id.description: The link's stable id, which ECore fills in and never changes: a rename keeps it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The link's name: lowercase words joined by hyphens, at most 64 characters. It names the link's connection task and its line in the status.

x-emc2.hint: Lowercase words with hyphens, e.g. feed-north

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: tcp-client connects to a peer; tcp-server lets peers connect, one connection each; udp sends and receives datagrams, one line each.

x-emc2.hint: How the link reaches its peer

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: in receives lines; out sends them; both does both on one socket.

x-emc2.hint: in receives, out sends, both does both

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the plugin runs this link.

host.title: Host
host.description: tcp-client: the peer to connect to. udp: where an out or both link sends.

port.title: Port
port.description: tcp-client and udp: the peer's port.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: tcp-client: talk TLS, with a client certificate from the server's TLS credentials.

tlsCredential.title: TLS credential
tlsCredential.description: The TLS credential the link uses, from those the server's local configuration names. Empty: the credential named like the link.

listen.title: Listen on
listen.description: tcp-server and a receiving udp link: the local address and port. The address is 127.0.0.1, only this computer, unless an administrator sets another.

address.title: Address
address.description: The local address to listen on; 0.0.0.0 receives from the network.

port.title: Port
port.description: The local port to listen on.

idleSeconds.title: Idle seconds
idleSeconds.description: A TCP link that receives and gets nothing for this long connects again; 0: never.
